issues: 四张卡各用一种高饱和色相（蓝/紫/绿/橙）堆成彩虹，卡内只有标题 + 两根彩色骨架条
总览卡 2.2 预除后仍偏大，被前景 STEP 01 卡压住 “See everything” 的字
相机飞行在空无一物的径向渐变里进行，没有任何空间参照，旋转站读不出“世界在转”
三段飞行 inOutCubic 对称、无运动模糊，落位后卡片完全静止
DesignStage 默认 transform 放大，卡内小字按 480 宽栅格化再放大 4 倍
changes: 统一深色材质卡（上亮下暗微渐变、0.5px 发丝线、顶部内高光、两层深色软影）+ 单一靛蓝强调色；卡内改出版级内容：步号徽标、标题、一句说明、该站 pose 读数 chip（x 520 / ry −40° …）、三点进度路径
总览卡内容预除改 2.9、总览站 x 220→235，四卡同框互不压字；总览卡内放三步目录
世界里铺一张 translateZ(−1100) 的远景点阵平面（径向遮罩淡出），飞行与 90° 翻转时有视差和方位感；背景换暗场 Backdrop + 颗粒
飞行曲线改不对称 bezier(0.62,0,0.22,1)，飞行段做时间采样运动模糊（快门 0.5f，子帧数按相机位移自适应 4–12）；落位后当前卡沿法线浮起 10px、影子变大
DesignStage 改 raster="zoom"，卡内文字按目标尺寸栅格化
issuesEn: Each of the four cards uses its own saturated hue (blue/purple/green/orange), forming a rainbow, and each holds only a title plus two coloured skeleton bars
Even with the 2.2 pre-divide the overview card is too big and the foreground STEP 01 card covers the 'See everything' text
The camera flies through an empty radial gradient with no spatial reference, so the rotation stops never read as 'the world turning'
The three flights use symmetric inOutCubic with no motion blur, and cards sit completely still after landing
DesignStage's default transform scaling rasterises small card text at 480 wide and then magnifies it 4x
changesEn: Unified dark material cards (subtle top-to-bottom gradient, 0.5px hairline, top inner highlight, two-layer dark soft shadow) with a single indigo accent; content is publication-grade: step badge, title, one-line note, pose readout chips for that stop (x 520 / ry −40° …) and a three-dot progress path
The overview pre-divide is now 2.9 and its stop moves from x 220 to 235, so all four cards share the frame without covering text; the overview card holds a three-step index
A distant dot-grid plane at translateZ(−1100) with a radial fade gives parallax and orientation during flights and the 90° roll; the background is a dark Backdrop with grain

Flights use an asymmetric bezier(0.62,0,0.22,1) with temporal-sampling motion blur (0.5f shutter, 4–12 samples adaptive to camera travel); after landing the active card lifts 10px along its normal with a larger shadow
DesignStage now uses raster="zoom" so card text rasterises at target size
